description_en: Retrieves the details of a specific data center
description_zh: 获取单个数据中心详情
kebab_example: aliyun cassandra describe-data-center --cluster-id cds-t4n98w89z7700000 --data-center-id ap-southeast-1a --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDataCenter

parameters.help_en: The data center ID. You can call the DescribeDataCenters operation to obtain the data center ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心Id，可通过DescribeDataCenters获得相应的数据中心Id
parameters.name: data_center_id

AutoRenewPeriod.description_en: The auto-renewal period. This parameter is returned only when PayType is set to Subscription and AutoRenewal is set to true. Unit: months. Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, and 36
AutoRenewPeriod.description_zh: 付费周期，PayType（付费类型）为Subscription并且AutoRenewal（自动续费）为true时会有此结果，单位为月，取值：1-9，12，24，36

AutoRenewal.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled. This parameter is returned only when PayType is set to Subscription. Valid values:
true: Auto-renewal is enabled.
false: Auto-renewal is disabled
AutoRenewal.description_zh:
是否要自动续费。当参数PayType取值Subscription时才会有此值。取值：
true：自动续费。
false：不自动续费

CommodityInstance.description_en: The commodity instance ID of the cluster

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the cluster was created. Format: HH:mmZ (UTC)
CreatedTime.description_zh: 集群创建时间。格式：HH:mmZ（UTC 通用标准时，以Z来标识）

DataCenterId.description_en: The data center ID of the cluster

DataCenterName.description_en: The name of the data center in the cluster

DiskSize.description_en: The disk storage size per node. Unit: GB
DiskSize.description_zh: 磁盘存储大小（每节点，单位GB）

DiskType.description_en:
The disk storage type. Valid values:
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
cloud_essd: Enterprise SSD (ESSD).
cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
local_ssd_pro: local SSD
DiskType.description_zh:
磁盘存储类型。可取值示例：
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘
local_ssd_pro：本地SSD盘

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the cluster subscription. Format: HH:mmZ (UTC)
ExpireTime.description_zh: 集群订阅到期时间。格式：HH:mmZ（UTC 通用标准时，以Z来标识）

InstanceType.description_en:
The instance type of the cluster. Valid values:
cassandra.c.large: 2 vCPUs, 4 GB memory.
cassandra.c.xlarge: 4 vCPUs, 8 GB memory.
cassandra.c.2xlarge: 8 vCPUs, 16 GB memory
InstanceType.description_zh:
集群实例类型。可取值部分示例：
cassandra.c.large：2核 4G
cassandra.c.xlarge：4核 8G
cassandra.c.2xlarge：8核 16G

LockMode.description_en:
The lock mode. Valid values:
None: not locked.
Expired: locked due to cluster subscription expiration.
DiskFull: locked due to full disk
LockMode.description_zh:
锁定模式。可取值：
None：未锁定
Expired：集群订阅到期锁定
DiskFull：磁盘已满锁定

PayType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
Subscription: subscription.
PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.
<note>Pay-as-you-go instances do not have an expiration time.</note>
PayType.description_zh:
付费类型：
Subscription：包年包月
PayAsYouGo：按量付费
<note>按量付费实例无到期时间</note>

RegionId.description_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query available region IDs
RegionId.description_zh: 地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看可用的地域ID

Status.description_en:
The running status of the cluster. Valid values:
Creating: The cluster is being created.
CreateFailed: The cluster failed to be created.
Running: The cluster is running.
Deleting: The cluster is being deleted.
DeleteFailed: The cluster failed to be deleted.
Deleted: The cluster has been deleted
Status.description_zh:
集群运行状态，可取值部分示例：
Creating：创建中
CreateFailed：创建失败
Running：运行中
Deleting：删除中
DeleteFailed：删除失败
Deleted：已删除

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query available zones. Use this parameter to specify the zone in which to create the instance
ZoneId.description_zh: 可用区ID，可调用DescribeRegions查询，使用此参数指定要创建实例的可用区
